independent_computation.question: Is Syndra's E (Scatter the Weak) an unconditional stun source, or is its stun conditional on a Dark Sphere being pushed into the target (i.e. does E depend on a sphere-generating cast such as Q)?

steps.claim: The base E active applies damage + knockback ONLY. No stun.
steps.quote: Active: Syndra propels a wave of force in a cone in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies hit and knocks them back for 400 units and up to 800 units away from Syndra based on proximity, though not through terrain.

steps.claim: The stun is a separate, strictly conditional effect: it fires only on enemies hit by a Dark Sphere that E knocked back.
steps.quote: Dark Spheres can be knocked back for 950 units and up to 1200 units away from Syndra based on proximity, knocking back enemies they hit over 70 units, though not through terrain. Targets hit are also stunned for 1.25 seconds, during which they are also revealed, and dealt Scatter the Weak's damage if they were not damaged by the initial cast.

steps.claim: Dark Spheres are CREATED only by Q (and, situationally, by R which conjures 3 and leaves them on the ground). W cannot create one - it only grabs an existing sphere/minion/monster and its throw applies a 25% slow, not a stun.
sources: data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.Q[0].effects[0].description: "Active: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location that appears after a 0.6-second delay, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds."

data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.W[0].effects[0].description: "Active: Syndra telekinetically grabs the nearest Dark Sphere, enemy minion or non-epic monster within 500 units from the target location..." and effects[2]: "...All targets hit are slowed by 25% for 1.5 seconds."
data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.R[0].effects[1].description: "Active: Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones..."

steps.claim: At the scenario's stack level (120 Splinters of Wrath) E still does not gain an unconditional stun. The only E Transcendent Bonus is at 80 splinters and it grants scatter angle + a 70% slow, explicitly sequenced 'after the stun has ended' only in the case where the target was hit by a pushed Dark Sphere.
steps.quote: Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 80 Splinters of Wrath enhances Scatter the Weak to have an increased scatter angle and slow enemies hit by 70% for 1.25 seconds starting after the knock back ends or if the target was hit by a pushed Dark Sphere, after the stun has ended.

steps.claim: Mechanical cross-check: the token 'stun' occurs nowhere in Syndra's cached ability text except inside E, and both occurrences sit in the sphere-collision paragraph and its 80-splinter follow-on. P/Q/W/R contain zero occurrences.
steps.method: Counted case-insensitive 'stun' occurrences over the serialized JSON of each ability slot in data/champions.json.

independent_computation.conclusion: A bare E with no Dark Sphere in the cone produces damage + knockback (+ a 70% slow at >=80 splinters) and NO stun. The stun is gated on a Dark Sphere being present to be knocked into the target, and the sphere must come from a prior cast - Q being the sphere generator in the modeled QE combo. Therefore the correct golden representation of this rotation source is a declared dependency ('E requires Q', a cc_enabler edge) rather than an authored unconditional cc_kind='stun' property on E. The old value asserted as an intrinsic property of E something the cached wiki text makes conditional; the new value encodes exactly the condition the wiki states, and carries a source citation instead of a module-authored constant.
residual_caveats: Strictly, the enabler SET is {Q, R}: R also conjures 3 Dark Spheres that 'remain on the ground next to the target's current location for 6 seconds', so an R-then-E line can also stun. Declaring Q as the cc_enabler is the conservative, standard-combo subset and is not wrong for this scenario's ordering constraint (Q before E), but it is not the complete enabler set. This is an under-declaration, not an incorrect declaration, and does not change the verdict.

The revision token 'Syndra@4024662' in the new value could not be independently verified from the export: data/wiki/article-index.json records Syndra only as pageid 641379 with no revision ids, and the string 4024662 appears nowhere under data/. The cache freshness that IS verifiable: data/.champions.json.meta fetched_at 1786113324.862417 (2026-08-07T14:35:24Z), and data/staleness.json reports Syndra 'stale': false with 0 stale ability rows.

docs/math-foundations.md does not define cc_kind / cc_enabler semantics (no occurrences of 'enabler'; its CC-adjacent content is limited to the rotation-cast renewal row in the audit table at line ~465). The arbitration therefore rests entirely on the cached wiki ability text, which is unambiguous.
